title: Cool blue/green versus warm red/orange UI colors in healthcare and finance apps
statement:
Cool blue/green UI color combinations elicit higher trust, calmness, and comfort than warm red/orange combinations in healthcare and finance app interfaces, increasing willingness to use the product.

Options:
- Cool professional: #1E90FF mid-blue / #2E8B57 mid-green (fits: trustworthy, calming, clinical)
- Approachable cool: #00CED1 teal / #3CB371 soft green (fits: modern health, fintech challenger)
- Warm urgent: #FF6347 warm coral / #FF8C00 orange (fits: alert states, high energy campaign)
- Conservative cool: #4682B4 steel blue + muted accents (fits: traditional bank, hospital system)
appliesWhen: Applies to: health, fintech. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Colour psychology in UI and UX design: Eliciting emotional responses through colour combination choices
source.authors: Design Journal study authors (2026 mixed-methods experiment)
